note: Original 28 unchanged; two source-informed CTE alias shadowing edge tests added before any application fix. Not an unbiased held-out benchmark.

cases.title: 销售总览
cases.query: 只查询 askdata_mock：统计2026年8月全部订单数和实付金额合计，不额外筛选订单状态。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id), ROUND(SUM(paid_amount),2) FROM orders_current WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-09-01'

cases.title: 客户等级销售额
cases.query: 只查询 askdata_mock：查询2026年8月各客户等级的销售额，按实付金额汇总，从高到低排序，不额外筛选订单状态。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_level,ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) FROM orders_current o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date>=DATE '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date<DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY c.customer_level ORDER BY 2 DESC

cases.title: 地区销售额
cases.query: 只查询 askdata_mock：统计2026年8月实付金额大于0的订单，按订单地区汇总实付金额。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region,ROUND(SUM(paid_amount),2) FROM orders_current WHERE paid_amount>0 AND order_date>=DATE '2026-08-01' AND order_date<DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY region

cases.title: 历史月度趋势
cases.query: 只查询 askdata_mock：查询2026年6月和7月各月实付金额合计，月份显示为YYYY-MM，不额外筛选状态。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT strftime(order_date,'%Y-%m'),ROUND(SUM(paid_amount),2) FROM orders_history WHERE order_date>=DATE '2026-06-01' AND order_date<DATE '2026-08-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.title: 商品品类销售
cases.query: 只查询 askdata_mock：统计2026年8月各商品品类的实付金额合计，不额外筛选订单状态。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category,ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) FROM orders_current o JOIN products p ON o.product_id=p.product_id WHERE o.order_date>=DATE '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date<DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY p.category

cases.title: 客户销售Top5
cases.query: 只查询 askdata_mock：统计2026年8月实付金额合计最高的5个客户，返回客户名称和实付金额合计，不额外筛选订单状态。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name,ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) FROM orders_current o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date>=DATE '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date<DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

cases.title: 电商支付总览
cases.query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：统计2026年8月1日至22日下单且实付金额大于0的订单数和实付金额合计。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id),ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) FROM orders o WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0

cases.title: 店铺销售Top5
cases.query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：统计2026年8月1日至22日下单且实付金额大于0的订单，返回销售额最高的5家店铺名称和实付金额合计。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT s.store_name,ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id=s.store_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0 GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

cases.title: 类目明细销售额
cases.query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：统计2026年8月1日至22日下单且订单实付金额大于0的订单，按商品类目名称汇总订单明细实付金额，取金额最高的10类。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.category_name,ROUND(SUM(i.paid_amount),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id JOIN product_categories c ON p.category_id=c.category_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0 GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

cases.title: 渠道销售额
cases.query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：统计2026年8月1日至22日下单且实付金额大于0的订单，按订单归因渠道名称汇总实付金额。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.channel_name,ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) FROM orders o JOIN acquisition_channels c ON o.channel_id=c.channel_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0 GROUP BY c.channel_name

cases.title: 广告收入成本比
cases.query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：汇总2026年8月1日至22日的广告归因收入和广告成本，并计算总归因收入除以总广告成本，比例保留4位小数。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(attributed_revenue),2),ROUND(SUM(ad_cost),2),ROUND(SUM(attributed_revenue)/NULLIF(SUM(ad_cost),0),4) FROM ad_daily_stats WHERE stat_date>=DATE '2026-08-01' AND stat_date<DATE '2026-08-23'

cases.title: 退款订单去重
cases.query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：对2026年8月1日至22日下单且实付金额大于0的订单，统计其中有退款记录的去重订单数、全部符合条件的订单数，以及前者除以后者的比例，保留4位小数；退款记录不限制申请时间和状态。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id),COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),0),4) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id=r.order_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0

cases.title: 店铺目标进度
cases.query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：查询2026年8月1日至22日每日店铺指标的GMV合计最高的5家店铺，返回店铺名称、该期间GMV、8月月度GMV目标和完成率，完成率为实际除以目标，保留4位小数。
cases.gold_sql: WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(gmv) g FROM daily_store_metrics WHERE stat_date>=DATE '2026-08-01' AND stat_date<DATE '2026-08-23' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_name,ROUND(a.g,2),t.gmv_target,ROUND(a.g/NULLIF(t.gmv_target,0),4) FROM a JOIN sales_targets t ON a.store_id=t.store_id AND t.target_month='2026-08' JOIN stores s ON a.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY a.g DESC LIMIT 5

cases.title: 订单状态分布
cases.query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：统计2026年8月1日至22日下单的订单，按订单状态统计订单数，不额外筛选实付金额。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_status,COUNT(o.order_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' GROUP BY o.order_status

cases.title: 注册平台分布
cases.query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：统计2026年8月1日至22日注册的用户，按注册平台汇总用户数。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT register_platform,COUNT(user_id) FROM users WHERE registered_at>=TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND registered_at<TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' GROUP BY register_platform

cases.title: 客单价
cases.query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：计算2026年8月1日至22日下单且实付金额大于0的订单客单价，定义为订单实付金额合计除以订单数，只返回客单价，保留2位小数。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount)/NULLIF(COUNT(o.order_id),0),2) FROM orders o WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0

cases.title: 一对多关联避免重复
cases.query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：统计2026年8月1日至22日下单、实付金额大于0且至少有一条订单明细的订单，返回订单数和订单级实付金额合计；每个订单只计算一次。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id),ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) FROM orders o WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id)

cases.title: 同类目订单去重汇总
cases.query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：对2026年8月1日至22日下单且实付金额大于0的订单，按商品类目名称统计订单级实付金额合计；同一个订单在同一个类目只计算一次，取金额最高的5类。
cases.gold_sql: WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id,o.paid_amount,c.category_name FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id JOIN product_categories c ON p.category_id=c.category_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0) SELECT category_name,ROUND(SUM(paid_amount),2) FROM a GROUP BY category_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

cases.title: 合法空结果

cases.gold_sql: SELECT region,ROUND(SUM(paid_amount),2) FROM orders_current WHERE order_date>=DATE '2027-08-01' AND order_date<DATE '2027-09-01' GROUP BY region
